description: Convert a raw attendee list into a professional check-in sheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/attendee_export_raw.docx, which contains tab-separated text. Perform the following actions: (1) Change the page orientation to Landscape to fit more data. (2) Convert all text to a table (Text to Table) using tabs as separators. (3) Format the header row (first row) to be Bold with a Light Gray background color. (4) Sort the table data (excluding the header) alphabetically first by 'Company' (Column 3), and then by 'Last Name' (Column 1). Save the finalized document as /home/ga/Documents/check_in_sheet.docx.
